description: A thin GUI client for the pi agent harness (pi on gui)
notes: Requires Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime. This build is unsigned.
pig and pig-nightly are separate Scoop apps sharing the pig shim and shortcut; installing both causes conflicts. Switch with 'scoop reset pig' or 'scoop reset pig-nightly'.
Exit all pig instances before updating or switching. Both builds share %LOCALAPPDATA%/dev.pig.desktop/stable; uninstall does not delete your data.
